capabilities: Read EPUB books in themed, font-tunable reader tabs
Auto-build a table of contents from headings when a book's TOC is broken
Capture selected passages and word translations into per-book notes and a dictionary
Fix typos by editing the EPUB file directly
Get AI translations, explanations and spoiler-safe recaps with a user-supplied API key
extras: Not yet in the community plugin catalog (listed in the roadmap); install via BRAT or manually, and the listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
motivation: Built by a humanities person who wanted her library to feel like a library.
problem: Obsidian cannot open e-books, so reading and note-taking happen in separate apps and quotes must be copied over by hand.

relations.evidence: spaced-repetition-ready line (word:::translation) — pairs perfectly with the Spaced Repetition plugin

requires.name: Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoint

summary: EPUB reader for Obsidian with themes, bookmarks and auto-built TOCs that captures quotes and vocabulary into notes, with optional AI recaps and translations.
